review_response_tasks.rationale: A：单数aunt作主语，不用have；B：单数主语在一般现在时用has；C：无be支撑，having不作此句谓语
A：钟表长指针不叫feet；B：eyes不能表示钟表指针；C：hands是钟表指针，后接show the time限定词义
A：指前文单数clock，用it；B：clock为单数，不能用they；C：叙述故障钟，we改变主语为我们
A：tick-tock是声音，listening to符合听觉；B：looking at不能以声音tick-tock为视觉对象；C：talking to不能以tick-tock为对话对象
A：盖子打开才能安装内部电池，合盖后安装倒置动作顺序；B：先装电池再合后盖，before符合操作顺序；C：without后不能接you close the back这一完整从句
A：water不能用于支付电池费用；B：普通paper不表示支付款，语境未给纸币，money最合适；C：to pay for the battery明确需要钱

student_passage: My aunt (1) ____ a small clock shop. I visit her on Saturday mornings. A clock has two long (2) ____ to show the time. Today a boy brings in a clock, but (3) ____ does not work. My aunt opens the back. I like (4) ____ the quiet tick-tock when she finishes a job. This clock makes no sound yet. “Put in a new battery (电池) (5) ____ you close the back,” she tells me. I do that, and it starts ticking. The boy smiles and gives her some (6) ____ to pay for the battery. My aunt lets me keep the old one for our class display.
filled_passage: My aunt has a small clock shop. I visit her on Saturday mornings. A clock has two long hands to show the time. Today a boy brings in a clock, but it does not work. My aunt opens the back. I like listening to the quiet tick-tock when she finishes a job. This clock makes no sound yet. “Put in a new battery (电池) before you close the back,” she tells me. I do that, and it starts ticking. The boy smiles and gives her some money to pay for the battery. My aunt lets me keep the old one for our class display.
